gaps.cause: printed section difference (bond proceeds among budget resources)
gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing and nothing is counted twice. Detail governmental revenue 3,268,115 = statement 2,648,115 (p5 Total revenues: General 1,376,595 + Street 585,921 + Sales Tax 391,546 + Debt Service 177,925 + Economic Development 10,039 + Keno 106,089) + 620,000. The 620,000 is detail 85, Debt Service Fund 'Bond proceeds' 620,000, printed on the p18 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Debt Service Fund among RESOURCES (INFLOWS) (Property taxes 174,642 + Bond proceeds 620,000 = Total resources (inflows) 794,642). The governmental funds statement prints the same 620,000 in the Debt Service Fund column under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), 'Bond/loan proceeds' (p6), so the JSON has it as debt_proceeds 620,000, not as a receipt. Same money, one detail line; it is the only detail line holding the debt proceeds, so it is not removed or relabelled (the schedule prints it as a resource). Per fund the detail revenue equals the statement column exactly: General combining schedule p14 1,376,595; Street p17 585,921; Debt Service p18 174,642 + Other 3,283 (p5 column, pass 6) = 177,925 excluding the bond proceeds; Sales Tax 391,546, Economic Development 10,039 and Keno 106,089 from the p5 columns. Without the 620,000 the schedule ties to the statement to the dollar.
